{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.86

|gr1= Warlords

|gr2= GUI

|eff= local

|descr= Display given text smoothly.

|s1= [text, nbOfLines, duration, color, outline] call [[BIS_fnc_WLSmoothText]]

|p1= text: [[String]] - text to display

|p2= nbOfLines: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 3) maximum number of lines to be shown at the same time

|p3= duration: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 5) on-screen duration

|p4= color: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]] - (Optional, default [1,1,1,1]) text color

|p5= outline: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[true]]) [[true]] to outline the text, [[false]] not to

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>["Hello, hidden FX", 2, 3, [1,0,0,1], true] spawn BIS_fnc_WLSmoothText; // no sounds, letters appear in a smooth transition</sqf>

|exec= spawn

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Notification]] [[BIS_fnc_titleText]] [[BIS_fnc_typeText]] [[BIS_fnc_typeText2]]
}}
